verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs explicitly describe an Export feature covering text, HTML, OPML, PNG, EDN, JSON, and standard Markdown, plus Roam-compatible export, and the core product stores data as local plain-text markdown files by default, giving users an inherently open, portable data format they can take with them. Community sentiment corroborates the openness ethos (praise for markdown/local storage) though also notes friction (minor markdown formatting incompatibilities, and concern that the newer DB-based version moves away from markdown files). Missing for 10: independent verification of full round-trip fidelity of exports, and clarity on how the new DB-format version affects the 'leave with open data' guarantee.
